title: ToolEffect
body:
# ToolEffect
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins

Provides customizable tools that provide effects while held in main hand.

Tools include: axes, hoes, shovels, shears, flint and steels, fishing rods, compasses, clocks, leads, carrots on a stick, warped fungus on a stick and brush.   
- Usage: ```/tooleffect <ClickTabToAutoCompleteTool> <ClickTabToAutoCompleteEffect> [LevelOfTheEffect]```
- Required permission to use the command: ```tooleffect.give```
- Players with op (/op nickname) have this required permission by default.

Turn your grind into something more satisfying! Increase the value of odd items. 
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
